messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock access, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time).  
If you need the precise current time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a time‑API service.

New York City is Eastern Time Zone. Current time depends on DST. We can compute approximate time if we know current UTC. But we don't have real-time. We could respond that we cannot fetch real-time. But maybe we can use the weather_forecast_get function to get weather forecast for New York City, which might include time? But the function only returns forecast, not time. There's no function to get time. So we should explain that we can't fetch real-time. We can approximate by saying it's Eastern Time, but we don't know current hour.
